printer.write.note: "Printed on the H89 through FujiNet.\r\n" appears in fujinet-pc's SD directory as file paper (build/runs/<run>/SD/paper; copied to build/runs/<run>/paper.txt). Printer type 1 (FILE_TRIM) writes the bytes unchanged up to the first 9BH. No fujinet-lib call: C uses fuji_bus_call

printer.status.nofield.trap: the field must be present (printer.cpp:241-244); fujinet-lib's DEVCALL_RV would be NAKed

printer.write.256.trap: length passed as uint8_t: 256 bytes print nothing, still ACK (printer.cpp:48; printer_emulator.h:68)

printer.write.300.trap: 300 mod 256 = 44: only the first 44 bytes reach the paper (printer.cpp:48)

printer.write.overrun.note: a WRITE of more than 320 bytes memcpy()s past the emulator's uint8_t buffer[320] (printer.cpp:46; printer_emulator.h:41, 72) and corrupts fujinet-pc: not sent
